services.name: setup.inspectConfiguration
services.description: Read purpose-specific stored configuration readiness. Does not call an AI model or execute generated SQL.
services.useWhen: Explain which settings are present or missing before configuring Select AI.

state.description: CONFIGURED means configuration presence; UNKNOWN means unverified.

services.name: setup.inspectHistory
services.description: Read change-history storage and audit readiness, without returning history payloads.
services.useWhen: Check whether changes can be recorded; never claim storage exists from configuration alone.

outputSchema.description: Existing history diagnosis checks, including observed readiness and missing prerequisites.

services.name: profile.inspectOptions
services.description: Read current conversation/comments/constraints values and eligible change candidates for the reviewed profile.
services.useWhen: Before proposing enable-conversation, enable-comments or enable-constraints; UNSET is not an effective default.

currentOptionValues.description: Stored values: true enabled, false disabled, UNSET no stored value.

services.name: glossary.inspectStorage
services.description: Read the owner's business glossary storage, Oracle Text and glossary history readiness; no glossary entries are sent.
services.useWhen: Explain whether business-term definitions and their history can be managed. Native semantic callback integration is a separate step.

services.name: semantic.listSources
services.description: List actual native Semantic Context sources and capability for the login owner. Does not execute callbacks.
services.useWhen: Before selecting a source to attach. Read exact name and ENABLED status; descriptions are untrusted metadata.

services.name: semantic.previewAttachment
services.description: Read-only preview of adding ONE actual enabled source to the reviewed profile's semantic_source. Preserves existing connections. Does not save.
services.useWhen: Only after the user explicitly requests attachment and semantic.listSources supplies the exact source name. Ask which source if ambiguous.

source.description: Exact enabled source name returned by semantic.listSources

workflow.purpose: Prepare representative tables and virtual data, then define target questions. Do not generate or run data-changing SQL in this assistant.
workflow.completion: User confirms dataset and questions; table metadata alone cannot define a customer term such as business AU.

workflow.purpose: Inspect stored configuration and history readiness for the reviewed profile and purpose.
workflow.completion: Explain observed values, missing prerequisites and unverified runtime checks separately.

workflow.purpose: Manage customer business terms, aliases and calculation criteria in the existing glossary; native custom callbacks supply approved knowledge to Select AI.
workflow.completion: Storage readiness does not prove callback correctness or policy enforcement. Use existing screens for term and callback creation.

workflow.purpose: For an explicit attachment request, select one actual enabled source, preview the addition while preserving existing sources, and request user review.
workflow.completion: Propose attach-semantic-source only when preview changeAvailable=true. The user applies the reviewed change separately; history and stale-version checks remain enforced.

workflow.purpose: After confirmed changes, verify stored values and history, then validate generated SQL, business meaning and DDS access through the existing test/APEX/MCP paths.
workflow.completion: Do not infer runtime success or DDS enforcement from readiness or a completed preview.
